heading: Investigations of flag officers and Senior Executive Service employees
lead: In conducting an investigation into an allegation of misconduct by a flag officer or member of the Senior Executive Service serving in the Coast Guard, the Inspector General of the Department of Homeland Security shall—

tree.text: conduct the investigation in a manner consistent with Department of Defense policies for such an investigation; and
consult with the Inspector General of the Department of Defense.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 430 of this title as this section.
